title: Kissed Charred Chinese Cassaba Bao
description: A charred, gooey, energizing Chinese dish featuring cassaba, leaf-wrap-steam, whole30-friendly, served in individual-mini-cocotte vessels, perfect for a healthy dinner option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the cassaba melon by dicing it into small pieces.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced cassaba melon to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until it starts to caramelize.
Add the chopped green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Prepare the banana leaves by cutting them into large squares.
Place a portion of the cassaba melon mixture onto the center of each banana leaf square.
Fold the banana leaves over the filling to form a packet and place them in individual-mini-cocotte vessels.
Steam the packets in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the leaves are charred and the filling is gooey.
